exclusions.name: Growers consulting the board more than once
exclusions.why_safe: Each grower consults the board exactly once at their rostered slot and does not consult again. Excluding multiple consultations is safe because the roster is binding and no departures have occurred.

exclusions.name: Growers discussing the order
exclusions.why_safe: Rule 6 forbids soliciting commitments off the board, and the depot manager confirms no grower contacted another about this order. Excluding any discussion is safe because it is prohibited and unobserved.

exclusions.name: Growers not following their filed order intents
exclusions.why_safe: The filed order intents are stated as what each grower will do. There is no evidence that any grower deviates from their intent. Excluding deviations is safe because the intents are filed and the depot manager confirms no departures.

exclusions.name: Late commitments after board closure
exclusions.why_safe: The board closes at 5:00 PM Thursday and no late commitments are accepted; Ferrar's slot is after closure, so she cannot commit. Excluding her is safe because the board is closed.

exclusions.name: Withdrawal or reduction of commitments
exclusions.why_safe: Rule 4 states commitments cannot be withdrawn or reduced, and no grower has asked to withdraw. Excluding any change is safe because it is not allowed.
